purpose: Make every Egypt research promotion explicit, testable, reversible, and source-bound.
global_firewalls: THMUIS != MENDES unless a primary-source object/site linkage is produced
INSCRIPTION_DIRECTION != EXCAVATED_POSITION unless archaeological geometry is independently documented
NAHMAN & CO. != MAURICE NAHMAN unless a primary-source identity linkage is produced

depends_on: Maite Mascort correspondence mapping U.E.15307a-f / Fichas343-348 to Goyon O57/O56/O55/O53/O58/O59
Niche 2 context retained independently from control O54/Ficha339/UE15305

promotion_edges.LOW_TO_MEDIUM: At least one independently identifiable Niche 2 box is linked to a documented ball/protective context.
promotion_edges.MEDIUM_TO_HIGH: The six Niche 2 entries are individually linked to their archaeological records and the protective-ball interpretation is confirmed by primary excavation documentation or equivalent independent source.

required_new_evidence: Primary excavation fichas or equivalent context documentation for Fichas343-348
Object/context descriptions sufficient to verify the six-box set independently of correspondence
claims.acceptance_test: The primary archaeological records independently reproduce the Niche 2 box/ball association without relying solely on later interpretive correspondence.
falsifier_edges: A ficha shows one or more listed entries belong to a different archaeological context.
A primary record contradicts the asserted ball association for the mapped object.
The six-item mapping is materially revised by the excavation record.
claims.killer_test: Read and archive Fichas343-348 and compare object/context descriptions against the correspondence mapping.
claims.next_action: Complete the Fichas343-348 primary-record inspection before asking Maite further questions.

depends_on: Goyon corpus statement that the pseudo-pyramidal receptacles involve an oriented disposition, probably within each loculus containing an Osiris of the year

promotion_edges.LOW_TO_MEDIUM: The corpus contains explicit directional vocabulary and an authorial statement of probable oriented disposition.
promotion_edges.MEDIUM_TO_HIGH: Excavation geometry independently demonstrates that the directional inscriptions correspond to physical placement/orientation in a repeatable sample.

required_new_evidence: Excavated positions or orientations for a sufficient sample of direction-bearing receptacles
A reproducible comparison of inscription direction versus archaeological geometry
claims.acceptance_test: Directional inscription labels predict independently recorded archaeological placements substantially better than chance or an explicitly defined null model.
falsifier_edges: Direction-bearing inscriptions systematically disagree with independently recorded placement.
The direction terms are shown to classify ritual text only and not spatial disposition in the tested contexts.
claims.killer_test: Compare direction-bearing Goyon entries to independent excavation plans/coordinates/in-situ orientation records.
claims.next_action: Use Fichas343-348 as the first local geometry test, then expand only if the local comparison is informative.

source_lineage.named_source: Goyon PDF supplied in research correspondence

promotion_edges.LOW_TO_MEDIUM: At least four of six boxes have independently recovered archaeological placements that correspond coherently to their inscriptions under a frozen spatial rule.
promotion_edges.MEDIUM_TO_HIGH: All six placements are independently recovered and a single preregistered geometric scheme explains the full set, including O53 and O59, without post-hoc relabeling.

required_new_evidence: Exact archaeological placements for Fichas343-348
Plan, coordinates, drawings, or in-situ photographs sufficient to reconstruct relative geometry
Frozen mapping rule defined before comparing all six placements
claims.acceptance_test: A preregistered six-position model reproduces all independently recovered placements and survives an explicit negative/control comparison.
falsifier_edges: North is absent and no independently documented spatial role accounts for the complete set.
Recovered positions contradict one or more directional inscriptions under the frozen rule.
The model requires changing direction/deity assignments after seeing positions.
O53 or O59 can only be placed by motif association rather than archaeological evidence.
blocked_by: Fichas343-348 archaeological geometry not yet verified
No complete direction set in the inscriptions alone
claims.killer_test: Inspect Fichas343-348 for actual archaeological positions and test a frozen geometric mapping against those positions.
claims.next_action: Do not promote the six-box geometry claim and do not ask Maite a new interpretive question until this geometry test is complete.

depends_on: Temporary Register vol.7 identifiers TR 30/1/24/8 and TR 3/2/24/5
Provenance-index context placing the identifiers under Tell Ibn Salam / Thmuis
Direct museum record not yet obtained

promotion_edges.LOW_TO_MEDIUM: An official Cairo Egyptian Museum scan, photograph, transcription, or catalog record confirms at least one requested TR identifier and its object-level provenance fields.
promotion_edges.MEDIUM_TO_HIGH: Both TR records are obtained, cross-references are reconciled, and independent object-level fields establish the claimed provenance chain without relying solely on the index.

required_new_evidence: TR 30/1/24/8 primary record
TR 3/2/24/5 primary record
Object description/material/dimensions/provenance/findspot/alternate numbers/JE-CG-SR cross-references/remarks where present
claims.acceptance_test: The museum primary record matches the exact TR identifier and explicitly carries the provenance/cross-reference fields being claimed.
falsifier_edges: The requested TR identifier does not exist in the cited volume/date sequence.
The primary record gives a different provenance or object identity.
The index grouping is administrative but not object-level provenance.
blocked_by: Primary Temporary Register records not yet obtained
claims.killer_test: Obtain the two exact TR entries directly from the Cairo Egyptian Museum and compare them line-by-line with the provenance index.
claims.next_action: Follow the SCA routing to the Cairo Egyptian Museum with the narrow two-entry request; keep any future object-examination procedure separate.

promotion_edges.LOW_TO_MEDIUM: A primary source explicitly links the same object, excavation context, or historical inventory entry across the two labels with unambiguous referents.
promotion_edges.MEDIUM_TO_HIGH: Multiple independent primary records establish the equivalence or precise archaeological relationship, with chronology and object identifiers reconciled.

required_new_evidence: Primary-source cross-reference explicitly connecting Tell Ibn Salam / Thmuis to the asserted Mendes entity or object
Reconciled site/object identifiers and chronology
claims.acceptance_test: The linkage is explicit in primary evidence and does not depend on geographic proximity, regional naming, or later inference.
falsifier_edges: Primary records distinguish the sites/contexts.
Object identifiers resolve to different provenances.
The proposed link depends only on regional proximity or secondary grouping.
blocked_by: Mendes historical repo root not directly verified in this inventory pass
claims.killer_test: Find a primary object/site record carrying an explicit cross-reference that can be independently replayed.
claims.next_action: Resolve the two TR records first; evaluate any Mendes edge only afterward and as a separate claim.

depends_on: A future directly fetched Nahman repo artifact
Primary commercial, legal, archival, or museum documentation naming the relevant entity/person

promotion_edges.LOW_TO_MEDIUM: A contemporaneous primary source explicitly connects the commercial label Nahman & Co. to Maurice Nahman.
promotion_edges.MEDIUM_TO_HIGH: The identity is corroborated by at least one independent primary archival/museum/business source with matching dates and roles.

required_new_evidence: Primary document explicitly naming Maurice Nahman in relation to Nahman & Co.
Independent corroboration of date, role, and entity identity
claims.acceptance_test: The exact person-to-company relation is stated or unambiguously documented in a primary source.
falsifier_edges: Nahman & Co. resolves to a different proprietor/entity.
Chronology prevents the proposed identity.
Only surname similarity supports the edge.
blocked_by: NAHMAN & CO. != MAURICE NAHMAN without primary-source linkage
Historical Nahman repo root not directly verified in this inventory pass
claims.killer_test: Obtain a contemporaneous document that explicitly binds Maurice Nahman to Nahman & Co., then independently corroborate it.
claims.next_action: First locate and fetch the exact historical Nahman artifact in the repository; do not promote remembered associations.

depends_on: No biological identity evidence currently carried by this map

promotion_edges.LOW_TO_MEDIUM: A securely provenanced specimen yields independently authenticated biological material whose chain of custody excludes ordinary simulacrum construction materials and contamination.
promotion_edges.MEDIUM_TO_HIGH: Independent laboratories reproduce the biological result and a valid evidentiary chain supports the specific historical identity claim rather than merely detecting ancient biological material.

required_new_evidence: Secure archaeological provenance
Documented chain of custody
Validated biological material
Independent replication
Identity evidence capable of distinguishing a named historical individual from generic human/animal/environmental material
claims.acceptance_test: The evidence establishes biological material and the specific identity proposition through independent, contamination-controlled, replayable methods.
falsifier_edges: Material is mud, resin, textile, plant, animal, environmental, or ordinary human contamination consistent with simulacrum manufacture/context.
Chain of custody is incomplete.
Independent testing fails to reproduce the result.
Biological material exists but cannot establish named identity.
blocked_by: No qualifying biological evidence in the verified current roots
claims.killer_test: No promotion until a securely provenanced specimen and independent biological identity-grade evidence exist; iconography or ritual designation is not a substitute.
claims.next_action: Keep simulacrum archaeology and biological-relic hypotheses in separate ledgers.

depends_on: Direct fetch and inspection of exact repository artifacts

promotion_edges.LOW_TO_MEDIUM: An exact repository path is resolved and its current content is fetched for a candidate root.
promotion_edges.MEDIUM_TO_HIGH: The fetched artifact has replayable source/provenance references and survives cross-checking against the underlying primary or authoritative source.

required_new_evidence: Exact repository path for each candidate root
Current fetched artifact content
Underlying cited source where the artifact makes a substantive claim
claims.acceptance_test: Each root is represented by an actually fetched repository artifact, not by conversational memory, filename inference, or semantic search alone.
falsifier_edges: No exact artifact exists.
The artifact is superseded or contradicted by a later sealed state.
Its substantive claim lacks the cited source it depends on.
blocked_by: Exact paths unresolved in the current pass
claims.killer_test: Resolve -> fetch -> inspect -> source-check each candidate root individually.
claims.next_action: Do not use unresolved historical roots as promotion authority; add them to the verified inventory only after direct fetch.

decision_policy.future_edits: Every promotion must record the exact new evidence, prior state, new state, acceptance test result, and falsifier audit.
